additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441769-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / R1 170001369] Charging Issue CRM:02832000281
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Szymon,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0441769
. Apologies for the late reply. The ticket has been opened for issues to charge with DC1 of charger
mtSXKB
on 04.08.2025.
Here are the results of my analysis from the logs:
At 2025-08-04T11:36:33 I see that the DEBUG Mode was activated on SCB. I believe this was a monitored test session then? The EV used is the following EVMAC 00.18.23.ab.9f.31.
DC1 was connected, but I see an unusual variation of the CP line state. A-B-A in few seconds, then when the pilot was E, it switches to B.
At 2025-08-04T11:50:21 the same vehicle is connected to DC2, and the session starts without any issue.
At 2025-08-04T11:58:40 a reboot of the charger is launched
At 2025-08-04T12:05:05 both outlets becomes available again after reboot
At 2025-08-04T12:06:56 DC1 is connected. At 2025-08-04T12:07:23 the pilot state goes back to A, and we see EcoG error 54 "ERR_EVCOM, EV communication problem detected". Seems like the EV was not ready. Again though, I see an incorrect pilot state change sequence: A-B-A-E-B
At 2025-08-04T12:08:13 DC1 one is connected again, and finally we see P01_Authentication starting. The charging session is successful.
At 2025-08-04T12:22:18 DC1 is connected again, and again the charging session starts correctly.
In my eyes, it looks like the issue on DC1 could be related to the mating between DC1 plug and EV socket. From the logs it looked like the plug was not perfectly inserted in the EV socket, or that some dirt in the plug or in the socket interfered with the CP signal.
I would suggest to check that DC1 plug does not present any sign of dirt/dust or damaged blade/hot spots. Also, I would suggest to check the DC1 mating frame of the plug, to see if there are signs of tear and wear on the mating frame, resulting into a non efficient and smooth mating between plug and EV socket.
Please let me know if you need further support for this ticket, otherwise I will proceed to close it.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
